biggest_catch: Both sides only earn per product the friend actually sets up - if the friend just opens checking without direct deposit or a loan, you only get $10 for that referral, not $50.
catches: Referrer earns tiered: $10 when friend opens Free Checking + $10 when direct deposit is confirmed + $30 when friend applies for a car/personal loan (up to $50 per referral); friend earns the same tiers.
No limit on the number of members an existing member can refer; limit one offer per new member.
Friend must present the referral card at account opening; all services must be added at initial account opening except direct deposit, which must be confirmed within 45 days.
Minimum $50 deposit in checking to qualify for the checking bonus; friend must notify the credit union when direct deposit is added.
Funds earned are considered interest income, reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Membership: live, work, worship, or attend school in Dutchess, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Sullivan, Ulster, or Westchester Counties, NY ($5 initial deposit).
TEG reserves the right to discontinue the program at any time without advance notice.
